descriptors.label: Description
descriptors.help: Literal explanatory content, never executable markup.

descriptors.label: Aliases
descriptors.help: Alternative display/search names; do not introduce duplicate semantic identities.

descriptors.label: Kind
descriptors.help: Canonical registry ID after alias resolution; display look cannot change it.
descriptors.warning: Changing kind re-types every occurrence of this definition in every view that uses it.

descriptors.label: Level
descriptors.help: Omission is permitted in sketches; a view occurrence is not a data level.

descriptors.label: Maturity
descriptors.help: Independent of style, runtime health and evidence.

descriptors.label: Meaning
descriptors.help: Semantic definition; no implicit datatype selection.

descriptors.label: Workload
descriptors.help: An explicitly mixed workload may carry multiple compatible values.

descriptors.label: Role
descriptors.help: Include authority or replica scope where claimed; incompatible roles require distinct assertions.

descriptors.label: Location
descriptors.help: Applicable to deployment scopes and instances; not automatic placement for abstract concepts.

descriptors.label: Distribution
descriptors.help: Requires a declared partition policy before physical implementation claims.

descriptors.label: Representation
descriptors.help: Domain-to-platform representation, not a universal datatype.

descriptors.label: Shape
descriptors.help: Structural category; optional nested fields do not imply a separate stored object.

descriptors.label: Key
descriptors.help: A shorthand single key role. Composite/multiple roles require referenced key definitions.

descriptors.label: Domain
descriptors.help: Established meaning binding, not a candidate suggestion or an SQL datatype.

descriptors.label: Datatype
descriptors.help: Physical profile interprets it; parser never assumes a vendor type universally exists.

descriptors.label: Presence
descriptors.help: Required presence and nullable values are independent.

descriptors.label: Nullable
descriptors.help: True permits null; it does not mean the property can be absent.

descriptors.label: Min items
descriptors.help: Arrays/sets; must not exceed max_items when finite.

descriptors.label: Max items
descriptors.help: Arrays/sets; is not maximum rows in a dataset.

descriptors.label: Ordered
descriptors.help: A set defaults are not invented from examples; ordering scope must be explicit.

descriptors.label: Unique
descriptors.help: State whether item identity/value uniqueness is intended; enforcement is separate.

descriptors.label: Default
descriptors.help: Record distinguishes a literal value from code; drawing never evaluates it.

descriptors.label: Generated
descriptors.help: Name language, text and evaluation scope; no evaluation during rendering.

descriptors.label: Discriminator
descriptors.help: Union variants must specify unique matching cases where closed/discriminated.

descriptors.label: Variants
descriptors.help: Each target is a shape definition; mutual recursion must be represented without infinite expansion.

descriptors.label: Allowed values
descriptors.help: Exhaustive only when explicitly declared; never inferred from samples.

descriptors.label: Unit
descriptors.help: Quantity meaning, conversion and precision are defined by the unit profile.

descriptors.label: Normalization
descriptors.help: Does not silently transform identifiers or literal source sample values.

descriptors.label: Equality
descriptors.help: Explicit comparison scope; physical collation binding can differ by platform.

descriptors.label: Platform
descriptors.help: Binding applicability, not a remote service to contact.

descriptors.label: Platform version
descriptors.help: Physical profile version; cannot be replaced silently by latest.

descriptors.label: Precision
descriptors.help: Applicable representation specifies decimal/binary/significant-digit interpretation.

descriptors.label: Scale
descriptors.help: Applicable numeric binding supplies units and valid range.

descriptors.label: Kind
descriptors.help: Normalizes to a fixed family, verb, orientation and compatible endpoints.
descriptors.warning: Changing kind re-types every occurrence of this definition in every view that uses it.

descriptors.label: Source mark
descriptors.help: Valid only where relation semantics permit participation or composition.

descriptors.label: Target mark
descriptors.help: At target B describes how many B instances per one A; never packet count.

descriptors.label: Enforcement
descriptors.help: A drawn relation does not imply database enforcement.
descriptors.warning: Enforcement changes this relation’s contractual meaning in every view that renders it.

descriptors.label: Scope
descriptors.help: Authority, delivery, ordering or other qualifier's named scope.

descriptors.label: Source min
descriptors.help: Structural participation lower bound at source; must not exceed finite source_max.

descriptors.label: Source max
descriptors.help: Explicit bounds supersede compact endpoint shorthand only consistently.

descriptors.label: Target min
descriptors.help: Structural participation lower bound at target.

descriptors.label: Target max
descriptors.help: Explicit numeric limits must agree with compact displayed symbols.

descriptors.label: Capture
descriptors.help: Capture method is separate from transport and transformation.

descriptors.label: Transport
descriptors.help: For example kafka; no delivery guarantee is inferred from the name.

descriptors.label: Transformation
descriptors.help: An overview description should refine to activities when detailed validation is required.

descriptors.label: Cadence
descriptors.help: Schedule/timezone is additional when relevant.

descriptors.label: Delivery
descriptors.help: Delivery record fields required and verified remain independent assertions.

descriptors.label: Payload
descriptors.help: Payload identity/version, not a copy of the schema inside every connector.

descriptors.label: Ordering
descriptors.help: Total/per-key/per-partition ordering must identify the relevant stream and key.

descriptors.label: Initial load
descriptors.help: Initial snapshot/catch-up coordination is not implied by CDC.

descriptors.label: Delete handling
descriptors.help: Explicit deletion/tombstone policy; drawing an arrow does not establish completeness.

descriptors.label: Retry
descriptors.help: Attempts, backoff and exhaustion target; not an execution loop inferred from geometry.

descriptors.label: Freshness
descriptors.help: Duration is measured relative to the declared clock and observation point.

descriptors.label: Temporal
descriptors.help: Temporal categories do not imply PITR or complete reconstructability.

descriptors.label: Time
descriptors.help: Keyed valid and recorded axes or overview descriptions; production requires field/system/interval details.

descriptors.label: Time.valid
descriptors.help: Contains start/end field refs, business clock, interval semantics and open-end representation.

descriptors.label: Time.recorded
descriptors.help: Contains start/end fields, named recording system and correction semantics.

descriptors.label: Time.retention
descriptors.help: Retention scope must identify which axes, rows, logs or snapshots it covers.

descriptors.label: Time.event
descriptors.help: Occurrence time; distinct from arrival and processing timestamps.

descriptors.label: Time.arrival
descriptors.help: Ingestion timestamp of a named system; not automatically business-valid time.

descriptors.label: Time.processing
descriptors.help: Processing timestamp tied to an execution/system.

descriptors.label: Snapshot at
descriptors.help: Consistency scope and source completeness must be explicit for recovery claims.

descriptors.label: Recovery window
descriptors.help: PITR scope, oldest/newest recoverable state, backup/log evidence.

descriptors.label: Provider
descriptors.help: Provider identity; never infer region or capabilities from a logo.

descriptors.label: Region
descriptors.help: Scope within provider/account; not a globally unique bare region token.

descriptors.label: Environment
descriptors.help: Intended environment; production does not imply healthy.

descriptors.label: Partition key
descriptors.help: All fields belong to the partitioned definition or an explicit mapping.

descriptors.label: Partition rule
descriptors.help: Hash/range/version and boundaries are explicit policy information.

descriptors.label: Replication factor
descriptors.help: State whether the primary is counted and which fragment/set the count applies to.

descriptors.label: Replica role
descriptors.help: Belongs to a copy with named coordination scope and observation time when observed.

descriptors.label: Consistency
descriptors.help: Scope must specify read/write/replication semantics rather than one unlabeled word.

descriptors.label: Residency
descriptors.help: Allowed locations and evidence are separate; a frame alone is not proof.

descriptors.label: Owner
descriptors.help: Responsibility relationship, not physical containment.

descriptors.label: Classification
descriptors.help: Inheritance only under an explicitly selected governance profile.

descriptors.label: Contract
descriptors.help: Contract version and producer/consumer roles remain resolvable.

descriptors.label: Quality
descriptors.help: Validation result and requirement are independent.

descriptors.label: Dialect
descriptors.help: SQL dialect/platform profile; syntax is not executed by the renderer.

descriptors.label: Definition
descriptors.help: Explicit content/language; remote content is not fetched without resolver authority.

descriptors.label: Parameters
descriptors.help: Parameters are not mislabeled as storage columns.

descriptors.label: Refresh
descriptors.help: Materialized view refresh method, schedule and scope.

descriptors.label: Index method
descriptors.help: Validated only against the selected platform/version profile.

descriptors.label: Motion
descriptors.help: Declarative SMIL animation of the relation route: flow travels markers along the route; pulse animates edge stroke colour/opacity; none renders a static edge. Renderer-emitted, deterministic, file://-safe.

descriptors.label: Marker
descriptors.help: Travelling marker shape for motion:flow and flow blocks.

descriptors.label: Marker size
descriptors.help: Travelling marker size in px.

descriptors.label: Marker color
descriptors.help: Travelling marker colour; defaults to the relation colour (accent for flow blocks).

descriptors.label: Rate
descriptors.help: Markers in flight on the route; >1 is a staggered particle stream (traffic-style). Values beyond the 32 DOM-honest cap warn (DDN-W016) and clamp at render time.

descriptors.label: Speed
descriptors.help: Marker travel speed along the route; hop boundaries are route-length/speed derived.

descriptors.label: Pulse color
descriptors.help: Pulse peak stroke colour for motion:pulse.
